headers.//: The SPA document must NOT be cacheable. CSP is delivered as a response HEADER, and a 304 revalidation does NOT carry it — RFC 9111 has the client keep headers absent from the 304, so a browser holding a pre-change copy goes on enforcing the OLD policy. Worse, editing only this file leaves index.html's bytes (and therefore its ETag) identical, so the 304 path never breaks on its own: on 2026-08-03 receipt uploads were still blocked by a CSP that had been fixed and deployed two days earlier. `max-age=0, must-revalidate` is NOT enough — it still permits the 304. Excludes the three paths with their own Cache-Control above so asset immutability is untouched.
